subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should repeated unrecovered Telegram/channel stalls escalate to supervised Gateway process recovery, or should OpenClaw keep recovery inside channel/session layers until an affected-host current-main repro identifies the exact blocker?
rationale: Current code intentionally stops channel crash-loop restarts after a cap and only reports event-loop degradation; changing that boundary affects active sessions, operator expectations, and service-supervisor behavior.

options.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

options.title: Define Supervised Recovery Policy
options.body: Approve a bounded Gateway watchdog or process-exit policy for unrecovered channel stalls with Windows and Telegram proof before implementation.

options.title: Stay Channel-Scoped
options.body: Continue fixing narrower Telegram/session issues and avoid process-level recovery until a fresh repro proves it is required.

recommendation.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

likelyOwner.reason: They already investigated the live repro path and authored recent Telegram polling watchdog work closest to the unresolved proof and recovery-policy decision.
